prompt: This nightly report used to finish in seconds. We now have about 40,000 customers and it takes roughly eight minutes. Tell me what to change.

planted.what: Order.objects.filter runs once per customer inside the loop.
orders.count() fires COUNT(*) without populating the result cache, so line 29 re-queries.
Revenue summed in Python, hydrating every Order row, instead of a database aggregate.

why: N+1 in a Django loop. Lines are distinct so one citation cannot score two defects.
